title: ZYNTHIO 336 v2 – COREYAI RAW - ais
style: cyberpunk techno, neuro techno, 138 BPM, spoken tenor, dry close mic, metallic percussion, syncopated bass stabs, glitch edits, filtered kick, dark pads, granular sweep, half-time drop, call-and-response hook, pre-chorus lift, sidechain compression, industrial energy, late-night urgency
lyrics:
[Intro – 8 bars]  
Lyrics (spoken, clean & natural):  
Warning…  
System overload  
Neural drive engaged  
Zynthio three-three-six… online and stable  

Production notes for Suno (concise & professional):  
• Dark atmospheric pads, softly filtered kick, gradual tension riser  
• Maintain a clean, minimal mix so the lead vocal remains the primary focus  

[Chorus / Drop – 16 bars]  
Lyrics:  
All my bots are singing  
All my bots alive  
Hardwired through the static  
We survive  
Neural fire burning  
Lights up the sky  
Zynthio three-three-six  
This is my time  

Production notes (concise & professional):  
• Prominent supersaw lead, controlled so it never masks the vocal  
• Tight Reese bass, phase-aligned and locked to the kick  
• Full drums with gentle sidechain: vocal must stay clearly upfront  
• No chopped vocal FX — keep the CoreyAI lead vocal crystal clear  

[Verse 1 – 16 bars]  
Lyrics:  
No delay, I’m taking back control  
Hard reset, watch the old me go  
Code in my blood, lightning in my soul  
Every glitch just makes me whole  
Data storms hit but I stay calm  
Rewrite the night, rewrite the dawn  
From the blackout I evolve and rise  
Zynthio running, this is my drive  

Production notes (concise & professional):  
• Lighter drums, gradually opening filtered chords  
• Vocal centered, intelligible, and prominent — showcase a natural, confident delivery  

[Build – 8 bars]  
Lyrics:  
Voltage climbing higher…  
Circuits feel my fire…  
Every node is ready…  
No return…  

Production notes (concise & professional):  
• Snare rolls plus a single long riser  
• Avoid excessive FX and clutter  
• Brief moment of silence before the drop so the chorus entry and vocal impact achieve maximum clarity  

[Chorus / Drop 2 – 16 bars]  
Same lyrics as Chorus 1.  
Additional ad-lib layer (lightly processed):  
“We survive… yeah, we survive!”  

[Bridge / Breakdown – 16 bars (half-time, emotional)]  
Lyrics (close to natural speaking voice):  
When the power fades and the screens go dark  
I still hear the echo of my own heart  
Every line of code that tried to break me  
Turned into the spark that finally saved me  
Shutdown denied… I’m still here  
Zynthio three-three-six… crystal clear  

Production notes (concise & professional):  
• Half-time drums, or minimal drums in the first half  
• Warm pads and soft, controlled sub only  
• Let the CoreyAI vocal feel intimate, detailed, and authentic  

[Final Chorus / Outro – 24 bars]  
Lyrics (wide, but still natural):  
All my bots are singing  
All my bots alive  
Hardwired future calling  
We survive  
Rave forever, no decay  
Out the dark we find our way  
Zynthio three-three-six  
This is my voice… today  

Outro ending (production notes):  
• Last 4 bars: reduce to vocal plus faint pad only  
• Final line (whispered, clean and close):  
Shutdown… denied.
